module_title: The Internet, Supercomputers, and Future Tech
introduction: This level covers the mechanics of the internet, India's journey in supercomputing power, and the disruptive modern technologies shaping our future.

core_concepts.title: Internet and WWW (World Wide Web)
core_concepts.description:
The Internet is the global 'network of networks'. 
- **WWW:** Invented by **Tim Berners-Lee** in 1989. It is the system of interlinked hypertext documents accessed via the internet. 
- **HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol):** The set of rules used to transfer data over the web. 
- **IP Address (Internet Protocol Address):** A unique numerical label assigned to every device connected to a computer network (e.g., 192.168.1.1).

core_concepts.title: Supercomputers in India
core_concepts.description:
The processing speed of a supercomputer is measured in **FLOPS (Floating Point Operations Per Second)**. 
- India's First Supercomputer: **'PARAM 8000'** (Developed by C-DAC, Pune in 1991). 
- The architect of India's supercomputing initiative is **Dr. Vijay Bhatkar**. 
- Current Top Indian Supercomputers: 'AIRAWAT', 'PARAM Siddhi', and 'Pratyush'. (The fastest globally as of recent years is 'Frontier' from the USA).

core_concepts.title: Cloud Computing
core_concepts.description: The delivery of computing services (servers, storage, databases, software) over the Internet ('the cloud'). This means your files are not saved on your local hard drive, but on massive servers located elsewhere in the world, accessible from anywhere (Examples: Google Drive, AWS, Microsoft Azure).

core_concepts.title: IoT (Internet of Things)
core_concepts.description: The network of physical objects ('things') embedded with sensors, software, and technologies that connect and exchange data with other devices over the internet. (Example: A smart AC you can turn on from your smartphone while leaving the office, or a smart fridge).

important_entities.name: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
important_entities.significance: AI is the branch of computer science dedicated to creating systems capable of performing tasks that typically require human intelligence (learning, reasoning, problem-solving). **John McCarthy** is widely recognized as the 'Father of AI'.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: The Internet is NOT the WWW!
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: People use them interchangeably, but they are different. The **Internet** is the physical hardware network (the cables, routers, satellites) that connects computers globally. The **WWW (World Wide Web)** is the software/information space (the web pages) that travels *over* that physical internet.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: A URL is the address of a given unique resource on the Web (like www.google.com). It 'Locates' a 'Resource' Uniformly.

exam_strategy_tips: Frequently asked in UPSC/NDA and SSC: 'What is the name of India's first supercomputer and which agency developed it?' Answer: PARAM 8000, developed by C-DAC (Pune).
